newsitem.title: USA: Standard Financial sells credit card ops.
newsitem.headline: Standard Financial sells credit card ops.

text.p: Standard Financial Inc said Thursday it sold its credit card operations for $1.1 million, adding about $0.04 to its earnings a share for the third quarter.
The sale will allow Standard Financial to lower its provision for loan losses, the company said.
The company provided no other details about the sale in a news release and company officials were not available for comment.
Earlier Thursday, Standard Financial reported a net loss of $1.0 million or $0.07 a share in the third quarter, including a $5.8 million charge to recapitalize the Savings Association Insurance Fund.
The company's stock was down 1/4 at 17-3/4 on Nasdaq Thursday.
